title.narrative: Life-Saving Emergency Food Security and Livelihoods Support in Response to Nigeria Flooding

description.narrative: The project will target heavily flood-impacted Local Government Areas (LGA) in the northeast state of Borno. Activities have been identified based on emergency needs assessment work undertaken with government and sectoral partners.Under the Food Security and Agriculture Sector, FAO will work with government partners to provide vaccinations to prevent animal disease in cows, sheep and goats, protecting the remaining assets of affected households. Under the Nutrition Sector FAO will work with local partners on the provision of Tom Brown, a Locally Produced Supplemental Food (LPSF) to identified malnourished children created by women-led cooperatives in the area, also supporting the local economy and production. The project will be implemented over a 6-month period and request USD 390,625 from CERF to complement ongoing efforts in the affected areas. Overall, the project will reach 27,178 households in the targeted areas.
